QuestInfo.name: Mission Free the Monsters
QuestInfo.0: Shulynch is sending me an SOS signal. Is there an emergency?
QuestInfo.1: Rolonay's old friend, Delli, who, in the past, worked with Rolonay to rescue the monsters that were spellbound by evil powers, is apparently now in grave danger. Shulynch wants me to help rescue her. I'll go and rescue Delli!
QuestInfo.2: I rescued Delli and learned how to become friends with monsters in return.

yes.0: Thanks. I need to rescue 'Delli' right now, can you help me? Delli is a monster who was with Rolonay at Mu Lung. I'm sure you've noticed it by now that Rolonay wasn't a person, no? The disguise wasn't very well-done, so... it's not hard to tell.
yes.1: The best way to describe Rolonay and Delli is that... unlike other monsters, they are more 'aware' of things. In the beginning, monsters and humans didn't hate one another. They coexisted peacefully. It wasn't until one day when the monsters collectively got swept away by the evil powers that engulfed the world, and turned against humans. Not so for Rolonay and Delli, though. They tried to lead their fellow stricken monsters back to normal.
yes.2: Rolonay found himself in a dangerous situation, and I wound up saving him and bringing him to The Nautilus. We tried to bring Delli with us too, but she refused, so we left her there at Mu Lung. Unfortunately, we just found out she's been captured by the monsters there. If l search the northern part of Mu Lung and you search the southern half, we're bound to find her. I'll take you there with me right now.

no.0: Do I have to find someone else...?

1.0: Again, thank you so much for rescuing me. I don't know how to repay you for all this... both Shulynch and you are the nicest people I have encountered. If you approach the monsters the same way you approached me, they may all end up becoming friends with you, as well. Please never lose the kindness you have in you.

yes.0: (Friends with the monsters... never lose the kindness.)
